info.name: Wattpad Font Change - Times New Roman
info.description: This style customizes the font and appearance of the Wattpad website. It changes the default font to Times New Roman, adjusts the font size for better readability, and ensures a more comfortable reading experience. This style is designed for users who prefer a classic, clean look with easy-to-read text. Ideal for those who want to enhance their Wattpad reading experience without distractions.
info.additionalInfo: Version 2.0 (2026 Update)This style has been updated for the 2026 Wattpad interface to ensure smooth reading and font compatibility.
